build_IterNATransformerModel: build an iterative non-autoregressive transformer model with configurable refinement steps and denoising ratio
run_forward_IterNATransformerModel: run the forward pass of IterNATransformerModel with source tokens and target tokens for iterative decoding
create_sequential_poisoning: create corrupted token sequences using sequential poisoning with replace, repeat, and swap operations
generate_gumbel_noise: generate Gumbel noise for stochastic sampling from decoder logits during iterative refinement
configure_inat_base_architecture: configure the base iterative NAT architecture with encoder decoder dimensions and dropout rates
